paper_metadata.title: Hybrid LLM + Higher-Order Quantum Approximate Optimization for CSA Collateral Management

experiments.description: Hybrid CSA collateral optimization pipeline using simulated annealing interleaved with micro higher-order QAOA jumps on binding subproblems, certified by CP-SAT. Evaluated on government bond / CSA collateral harnesses with three valuation regimes (m1, m2, sp) and three buffer/cash-cap settings (A/B/C).

algorithm.variant: Simulated annealing + micro higher-order QAOA (HO-QAOA) jump with warm-start from classical incumbent
algorithm.ansatz: Standard X-mixer QAOA with higher-order phase operators; higher-order terms compiled directly or via ancillas
algorithm.convergence_criteria: If improvement < 0.3% over S simulated-annealing steps, perform one HO-QAOA jump; accept only if objective decreases and feasibility holds; otherwise revert

hyperparameters.must_jump_rule: at least one HO-QAOA jump after S low-improvement SA steps
hyperparameters.ancilla_skip_rule: skip quantum jump if ancilla width exceeds nmax

problem_formulation.objective_function: min J = BaseCost_abs + λ Movement + µ CVaR + γ (U - Reff)+, subject to Reff <= U <= Reff + B and cash/issuer/class/currency/global caps
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Higher-order penalty terms encode caps, RA/MTA/window couplings; feasibility repair after quantum jump; CP-SAT certification; optional U-cap pre-check for minimal feasible buffer B*
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Higher-order Ising Hamiltonian HP = sum_j a_j Z_j + sum_{j<k} b_jk Z_j Z_k + sum_{j<k<l} c_jkl Z_j Z_k Z_l + ...

problem_instance.description: CSA-governed collateral allocation with integer lots, Schedule A haircuts, RA/MTA gating, concentration caps, and funding-priced overshoot; evaluated on government bond datasets and multi-CSA inputs

dataset_specification.description: 2009 New York-law bilateral CSA; USD base; USD/EUR cash and securities; eligible classes include government, agencies, corporates, TIPS, MBS; inventory proxy includes USD cash and UST ladder (6M-20Y), TIPS, Agency, AAA MBS, IG Corps; three harnesses: A (m1, buffer 25 bps, cash cap 20%), B (m1, buffer 10 bps, cash cap 15%), C (m2, buffer 25 bps, cash cap 20%)

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Per-lot valuation vi derived from haircut matrix; integer lots aligned to RA (cash) and $1MM coupons (bonds); scenario weights normalized for CVaR; spectral clustering used to select coupled subsets
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Three harness evaluations (A/B/C) comparing BL-1, BL-2, BL-3, and Hybrid; reported objective improvements of 9.1%, 9.6%, and 10.7% vs BL-3

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Compute Reff via RA rounding; derive per-lot valuations from haircuts; seed with BL-1 density greedy; build interaction graph from dual/gradient proxies and feasibility slacks; spectral clustering for subset selection
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Feasibility repair after HO-QAOA jump; CP-SAT certification with status, bounds, gap, and per-constraint slacks; governance artifact generation

speedup_claims.caveats: No runtime or computational speedup is reported; only objective improvement over BL-3 is given.

experiments.description: Micro higher-order QAOA jump subroutine used inside the hybrid pipeline to solve binding sub-QUBOs on selected variable subsets near constraint corners.

algorithm.variant: Micro higher-order QAOA (HO-QAOA) on binding sub-QUBOs
algorithm.ansatz: Standard X-mixer QAOA with higher-order phase operators e^{-i gamma H_P}; ancilla-based linearization for k > 2
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Single jump accepted if repaired candidate is feasible and improves objective; otherwise reject and revert

hyperparameters.ancilla_width_limit: if ancilla width > nmax, skip jump
hyperparameters.warm_start: optional angles initialized from previous values

problem_formulation.objective_function: Higher-order Ising subproblem encoding RA/MTA, window, and caps couplings on selected variables
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Higher-order penalties in HP; ancillas used for k > 2; repair step enforces caps/RA/MTA/window
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: HP = sum_j a_j Z_j + sum_{j<k} b_jk Z_j Z_k + sum_{j<k<l} c_jkl Z_j Z_k Z_l + ...

problem_instance.description: Binding subproblem extracted from CSA collateral allocation graph near plateau regions

dataset_specification.description: Subsets selected by spectral clustering of highly coupled lots; top-K nodes by dual magnitude; edge pruning by epsilon

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Build unitless interaction graph from dual/gradient proxies and feasibility slacks; select subset S with |S| <= nmax; compile higher-order terms; map ancillas back to variables after measurement
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Used as an iterative jump operator during search; acceptance based on objective decrease and feasibility

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Spectral subset selection; ancilla width estimation; preparation of |+>^n state; optional initialization from prior angles
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measurement z mapped back to lots; repair of caps/RA/MTA/window; feasibility check and objective comparison

speedup_claims.caveats: No explicit runtime, approximation, or speedup comparison is reported for the micro-HO-QAOA subroutine.

experiments.description: CP-SAT certification and feasibility diagnostics for the same CSA collateral optimization instances, including U-cap pre-check and minimal feasible buffer B* reporting.

algorithm.convergence_criteria: Return OPTIMAL/FEASIBLE/INFEASIBLE with incumbent, best bound, and MIP gap

problem_formulation.objective_function: Same weighted objective J = BaseCost_abs + λ Movement + µ CVaR + γ Overshoot with linearized CVaR and overshoot
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Exact constraint enforcement in CP-SAT; reports per-constraint slacks and infeasibility under too-tight U-cap

problem_instance.description: Certification of CSA collateral allocation incumbents under the same harnesses and constraints as the hybrid search

dataset_specification.description: Harnesses A/B/C with m1 or m2 valuation regimes, buffers 25 bps or 10 bps, and cash caps 20% or 15%

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Use incumbent from hybrid search; solve identical linearized model with CP-SAT; compute slacks for cash/issuer/class/currency/global caps
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Report solver status, incumbent, best bound, MIP gap, and per-constraint slacks; if U-cap infeasible, report B*

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Linearize CVaR with (tau, z_s); compute Reff via RA rounding; build identical constraints to hybrid model
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Return status, incumbent, best bound, gap, and per-constraint slacks; generate governance traces

speedup_claims.caveats: CP-SAT is used as a certification arbiter; no speedup claim is made.
